session_summary: Deploy session: PR #11 was merged into wrong branch (claude/unruffled-agnesi worktree branch instead of master), so deploy workflows never fired. Recovery: merged feature branch into local master, resolved agent template conflicts (v2.8.4 vs v2.9.0) keeping master's newer version, pushed to origin/master. Both Deploy Frontend and Deploy Backend completed successfully. Root cause: default base branch for PR was set to worktree branch, not master.
overall_notes: Critical pattern discovered: when a PR is raised from a branch that was previously used for another PR, the GitHub UI may default the base branch to the worktree branch (claude/unruffled-agnesi) rather than master. Always verify baseRefName when creating PRs from feature branches that have had prior PRs. The deploy workflow path filter (src/**) was correct — the issue was purely the wrong merge target. Also: gh CLI unavailable in Docker containers — deployment trigger commands must be run from host.
